postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU February 2019 addressing sheet defines integral KY, island code 1/2/3, a hyphen and four digits. The Postal (Amendment) Regulations, 2025 confirm paid unique company postcodes. Examples and regulation classes do not prove a current complete assignment, alias, validity, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area denominator.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed CIPS or UPU body publishes postal Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry. The Cayman Land Info Street Address layer is a street-address polygon service with no postcode field; island, administrative, street-address, parcel, building, office, box, Point, buffer, hull, cell and model geometry cannot be relabelled as a postal area.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, P.O. Box, official island name and integral KYN-NNNN postcode separately. Ordinary street-only mail is undeliverable under the UPU sheet.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store box sections, post offices, unique organization postcodes, routes and other service objects with their real type. A non-area object never becomes a postal Polygon/MultiPolygon without authoritative geometry.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic-address identity, separately permitted building identity or footprint and explicit reviewed relation. A postcode, box, street-address polygon, parcel, coordinate, proximity or AGID cell is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: A finder observation may validate a time-bound assignment only when terms, request, response, observation time and digest are retained. Derived or virtual geometry requires an explicit competent-authority code-to-feature crosswalk, compatible rights, edition, schema, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. A versioned crosswalk may relate exact postal evidence and independently licensed context without turning AGID, island or street-address geometry into Cayman Islands postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Public web access and blank ArcGIS copyright text do not establish AGID storage, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights. The Lands and Survey FAQ says purchased maps convey no rights and cannot be published without express written permission of the Chief Surveyor.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO KY and Grand Cayman, Cayman Brac and Little Cayman identities. Do not merge the territory or borrow assignments or geometry from another Caribbean jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, P.O. boxes, organizations, recipients, buildings and query logs can expose private or commercial context. Raw personal, customer and land-right data is excluded.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The 02/2019 UPU sheet, 2025 regulations, current assignments, aliases and geometry are time-dependent. Preserve edition, retrieved_at, valid_from, valid_to, supersession and SHA-256 independently.

stages.definition: Cayman Islands address-format and postal-source inventory only.
Digest-bound CIPS, UPU, regulations and Cayman Land Info format, delivery, unique-code, rights and no-proxy evidence.

M2 requires a current complete competent-authority release of every Cayman Islands Postal Service postcode assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and typed area/non-area object, including ordinary private-letter-box section codes and organization-specific unique postcodes, fixed by retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, exact bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The UPU February 2019 sheet establishes integral KYN-NNNN syntax, island-code semantics, private-letter-box delivery and examples, while the Postal (Amendment) Regulations, 2025 confirm unique company postcodes; neither body supplies a current complete assignment denominator or postal geometry release. Every drawable current code must reconcile to finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source feature identity, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Unique organization postcodes, P.O. boxes, post offices, routes and other non-area objects must display their real type and reason without a fabricated surface. Islands, administrative boundaries, street-address polygons, parcels, buildings, addresses, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells and models cannot be promoted without an explicit competent-authority postcode crosswalk and compatible rights. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real KY API/app, normalize KYN-NNNN, handle loading, no-match, multiple, API failure and invalid geometry, fit and render a translucent fill with clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear and re-search, and display selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: KY metadata, official format, delivery and rights/no-proxy evidence only; no real KY Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A current complete rights-cleared typed assignment denominator, immutable eligible geometry artifacts and real KY loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture postal surfaces from island boundaries, address polygons, offices, box sections or unique organization codes.
